text: Anything about Pharos print credit, balances, charges or refunds goes to Print Services, even when the ticket is written from or about a lab PC.

Any problem with a lab PC (login profile, software, peripherals, scanners) in Halvorsen Hall, Okafor Science Center or Brightwater Library goes to Lab Desktop East. These three buildings are east of College Ave.

Any problem with a lab PC (login profile, software, peripherals, scanners) in Ridgeway Engineering, Castellanos Arts Building or Tamarack Hall goes to Lab Desktop West. These three buildings are west of College Ave.
Final grades that are in the Canvas gradebook but missing from Banner or Self-Service Banner (grade passback) go to Registrar Systems, not LMS (Canvas).

Wi-Fi or eduroam problems inside the six residence halls (Aspen Hall, Birchwood Hall, Cedar Commons, Dunmore Tower, Elmhurst House, Fairview Hall) go to ResNet. Note that Birchwood and Fairview are residence halls, unlike Halvorsen, Tamarack and Ridgeway.
Wi-Fi or eduroam problems anywhere other than those six halls go to Telecom & Campus Network. This includes Willow Apartments and the Greek Row houses, which are student housing but are not ResNet.
Duo lockouts, a new or lost phone that blocks sign-in, and Duo bypass codes go to Identity & Access, even when the ticket names Canvas, MyNSU or email as the thing that is blocked.
Missing or stuck Panopto recordings go to Classroom & AV, not LMS (Canvas), because capture is run from the room hardware.
Respondus LockDown Browser and Respondus Monitor problems go to LMS (Canvas), including when LockDown Browser is missing or broken on a lab PC.
Licences and activation for Qualtrics, SPSS, SAS and MATLAB go to Research Computing, even when the machine is a lab PC or an office computer.

Questions or reports about suspicious emails, texts and links (including ones that claim to be from the registrar, financial aid, HR or payroll) go to Security & Phishing, not the team the message pretends to be from.
Desk phones, voicemail, call forwarding and Teams voice numbers go to Telecom & Campus Network.
FAFSA verification portal errors, Aid Hub login loops, Aid Hub document upload problems and aid package display errors go to Financial Aid Systems.

Captioning requests (including captions for Panopto or Zoom), JAWS, NVDA and other screen-reader problems, and alt-text or document remediation go to Accessibility Technology, even when they happen inside Canvas, Panopto or a classroom.
Student-worker, work-study and TA access to Banner forms goes to Identity & Access, not Registrar Systems.
GlobalProtect VPN problems and VPN setup questions go to Telecom & Campus Network.
Vague tickets that name no system, device, building or app go to Service Desk Tier 1 to be triaged.
Mailbox quota, shared mailbox access, calendar delegation and distribution list changes in Outlook/Office 365 go to Identity & Access. Outlook app crashes stay with the Service Desk.
Zoom licences, account upgrades, Zoom cloud recordings and Zoom Webinar go to LMS (Canvas), because Zoom is provisioned through the Canvas integration.
Bursar eBill, tuition payment plan and authorized-payer portal errors go to Financial Aid Systems, not Registrar Systems.

Canvas courses that are missing, or rosters that do not match Banner enrollment (students missing, dropped students still showing, section merges) go to Registrar Systems, not LMS (Canvas), because they come from the Banner feed.

Course evaluation survey problems (blank survey, wrong completion status, response-rate reports) go to Research Computing, because evaluations run on Qualtrics. Degree audit (DegreeWorks) stays with Registrar Systems.
Applying disability accommodations (extended time, separate room) to Canvas quizzes and exams goes to Accessibility Technology, not LMS (Canvas).
Lectern or podium PCs and teaching-station equipment in classrooms go to Classroom & AV, even when the classroom is inside a lab building such as Halvorsen, Ridgeway or Tamarack.
A compromised account (unrequested sign-ins, unrequested Duo pushes, spam sent from your mailbox) and lost or stolen devices go to Security & Phishing, not Identity & Access.
NSU-Guest sponsorship, guest codes and accounts for visiting scholars or speakers go to Identity & Access, not Telecom & Campus Network, even though it is Wi-Fi.
